work.author: Charles G. Herbermann and the Catholic Encyclopedia editorial board
work.description: The eleventh volume (1911) of the sixteen-volume Catholic Encyclopedia (New York: Robert Appleton Company, 1907-1912). Signed articles are cited by article title; the volume's container identity remains distinct from each contributor's article. Ferdinand Prat's article 'St. Paul' belongs to this volume.
work.title: The Catholic Encyclopedia, Volume 11
